expert ‍Interview: The 26th International Ice Sculpture Festival in Jelgava Discover the “_Story of the ⁣Universe_” at the 26th International Ice Sculpture Festival in Jelgava, Latvia. World-class sculptors will gather from February 7 to 9, 2025, creating stunning ice sculptures that will mesmerize visitors⁤ with their craftsmanship and artistry.
Interview with arctic Art Expert, ⁢Elara James
Theme: “The Story of the Universe” senior Editor: What inspired⁢ this yearS theme, ⁣”The⁢ Story of​ the Universe”? What message is the festival hoping to convey?
Elara James: The “_Story‌ of the ‍Universe_” theme reflects​ the vast and awe-inspiring nature of the ⁣cosmos, ​which is a perfect parallel to the expansive creativity of ice sculptors. It aims to take attendees on a journey through time and space, showcasing the beauty​ and​ complexity​ of the universe in a unique and ​visually stunning way.
Dates Senior Editor: Can you tell us more about the dates and how⁣ visitors⁤ can participate in‍ the event?
Elara James: Certainly! The open call runs from⁣ February 1st to February 8th, 2025, during which sculptors can submit their proposals. The ⁢festival itself will⁣ take place ​from February 7 ⁤to 9, 2025. Visitors ​can enjoy⁣ the intricate ice sculptures created by 32 world-class sculptors using over 80 ⁣tons of⁤ ice,all while experiencing the⁣ 항상_Photography⁣ and filming will be performed during the event._/captivating atmosphere of⁢ jelgava.
Location Senior editor: ⁤ Jelgava is a beautiful‍ choice for the festival. What makes Jelgava such a suitable location, and​ what⁣ can visitors ‌expect to see?
Elara James: ​Jelgava,‌ with its rich cultural ⁣heritage and picturesque landscapes, offers an ideal backdrop for this event. Visitors can⁤ look forward to team sculptures and various galleries that showcase the talent and diversity of the participating sculptors.The city’s charm and the ‌grandeur of the ice structures create a magical experience that is truly memorable.
Additional Details senior Editor: ⁤Are there any specific‌ details visitors should know before they go? Traffic restrictions, perhaps?
Elara James: Yes, visitors should definitely check out ‌the traffic restrictions and visitor details . Additionally, extended working hours for local tourist attractions have been ⁤arranged during the festival. Full details on this can be found here .These adjustments ensure that visitors ⁢can enjoy‍ everything Jelgava has to offer without any hassles.
Photography and Filming Senior ‌Editor: Will photography and filming be⁣ allowed during the festival?
Elara James: ‍ Absolutely! Photography ⁢and ⁣filming will be performed during the event.‌ Materials captured during these activities will be used ⁣to promote the event and for publicity purposes, helping to spread the beauty of the festival to a wider audience.
Concluding Remarks Senior ‍Editor: what can visitors ​expect to gain ⁣from attending the ⁤26th International ice Sculpture Festival?
Elara James: Visitors can expect a ‌breathtaking and immersive experience that​ combines artistry, culture, and nature. The festival‌ allows attendees to appreciate the skill and creativity​ of world-class sculptors while enjoying the scientific wonder of the “_Story of the Universe_”. It’s a unique ‍prospect that merges beauty and enlightenment,⁤ making it a must-visit event.
